title: Photo Shoot in Chicago’s Urban Jungle Garden
includes: Bright creative looks are welcome! (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Enjoy a private photoshoot in Chicago’s beautiful urban jungle at the Lincoln Park Conservatory.
During this 40-minute session, I’ll help you feel confident and relaxed while taking high-quality photos using iPhone, optimized for social media.

You’ll receive about 50 digital photos, including 5 professionally edited images, delivered via a private online gallery.
Please download your photos within 14 days after receiving access, as the gallery link will expire.
